revelations and will be removed out of his place. (D&C 124:45-46.) The
opportunity and obligation of the Saints to sustain the leadership of the
Church comes periodically in the appointed conferences. (D&C 20:61-62;
124:143-44.) Regarding this solemn procedure, Elder James E.
